record.one_liner: Open-source CRM with REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and a native MCP server for AI-assistant integration.
record.auth_notes: Vendor docs confirm OAuth as part of the developer stack alongside REST/GraphQL APIs. Community/GitHub references suggest API-key (personal access token) auth also exists for the REST API, but this session could not fetch a vendor page confirming that specific mechanism within budget, so it is left unasserted.
record.access_notes: Twenty Cloud offers self-serve signup with a 30-day trial ('Sign up for Cloud in under a minute and start your 30-day trial'); all plans reportedly include the REST/GraphQL APIs. Twenty is also open-source and self-hostable per its docs (Self-Host is listed as a developer pathway), which would give free unrestricted API access, but no verbatim vendor quote confirming free self-host API access was captured in this session, so the more conservative trial_self_serve is used.
record.api_breadth_basis: Vendor docs confirm REST and GraphQL API existence but the fetched pages did not enumerate resource families or endpoint counts; budget was exhausted before a detailed API reference page could be located.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve trial signup plus documented REST/GraphQL APIs and OAuth mean a toolkit can be built without a gatekeeping step, though exact API key provisioning flow was not directly verified.
